findings.title: Control-first authorization accepts an already-readable preauthorization EOF
findings.evidence: select.select may return both stdin authorize_close and a selected socket with EOF. The control branch runs first (47-60), verifies only cached eof flags, sets authorized=True, and emits close_authorized. The selected recv branch then sees b-empty (89,96), tests the newly true authorized flag (97), and records EOF without failure. Thus an EOF observable before authorization can be recategorized as authorized. Host live-actor handshake does not remove this race.
findings.required_repair: Process selected ready socket I/O before authorization; parse authorize command into a pending request. Keep authorized false until same selected pair remains live, no eof/error/failure exists, both queues are empty, and a fresh zero-time selected-socket read readiness check is empty. Readable socket defers authorization and is serviced while still unauthorized. Duplicate/malformed/other control while pending fails. Acknowledge only after commit at this observed quiet boundary. Preserve finite deadline and normal joins.
